note: THE POOL, QUIET (only with &seq=quiet). The visitor walks at their own pace. 'dark' = how dark each room's picture goes (0 = not at all, 1 = black); rooms not listed are not darkened. 'dimMs' = how slowly the darkness changes. 'flash' = the picture that is there only for a split second: 'room', 'ms' how long it shows, 'dark' how dark it is, 'before' / 'after' the rooms either side of it. There is no sound from 013 on (no soundscape plays there).
